There is a typo in the 'Criteria for 'Yes'' Section. 
'The authors have reported the data extracted from each eligible primary **study?** in the manuscript......' 

Mostly this criteria was easy to apply but it was not always obvious which data were used to calculate the effect sizes and conduct the meta-analysis, therefore it was not always obvious whether these had been included in the tables.
The phrase "report the data" is a bit vague. Does it mean the authors have to provide the raw data or shall we tick "yes" if the authors have listed what kind of data is included?
